temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth has been unusually curt over the past few days; when Keith asks if he upset her, she says no and explains she is dealing with personal stuff.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth might be upset with him, possibly because of a misunderstanding or an unknown mistake.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Elizabeth explicitly denies being upset with him and attributes her curtness to personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not upset with him; her short responses are due to personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Be understanding and offer support or availability if she wants to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth accepts his offer of a coffee break and thanks him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress, not anger at him, and may appreciate support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed/reinforced: Elizabeth is receptive to his support and accepts spending time together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is open to his support and willing to have a coffee break with him.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Have the coffee break with her and listen/support her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over coffee, Elizabeth shares more about her stresses, which seem severe; after Keith suggests professional help, she says she is hesitant about seeking it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress and has accepted his support, but he does not yet know the severity or her view on professional help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed/expanded: Her stress is severe, professional help might benefit her, and she is hesitant about it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is facing serious stress, may benefit from professional help, and is hesitant; he must be careful not to offend her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting her and gently encourage consideration of professional help without pressuring or offending her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn after the professional-help suggestion; when Keith apologizes for possibly overstepping, she says he did not overstep and that she appreciates his concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is severely stressed and hesitant about professional help; Keith hopes his suggestion was not offensive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: First changed to suspecting he may have embarrassed or overstepped with her, then changed again after she reassures him that he did not overstep.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not upset or embarrassed by his suggestion; she appreciates his concern, but the topic is a lot for her to think about.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Regretful and worried, then relieved but still concerned.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure her of his support, avoid pushing professional help, and remain available.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth responds openly and appreciatively to his offer to always be available; she says his support means a lot and that she feels better knowing she has it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth appreciates his concern and was not offended by his professional-help suggestion, but he may still be unsure how comfortable she feels.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed/confirmed: Elizabeth values his support and feels more comfortable around him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth values his support and feels more comfortable knowing she has it; their supportive relationship is positive.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain the supportive relationship and remain available for chats or breaks.
